name: @li-langverse/cursor-agents
description: Local Cursor SDK agent runner for li-langverse (mock backend for CI)

scripts.agents:test-auto-quota: npm run build && env -u CURSOR_MOCK node scripts/test-auto-quota.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && LI_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE=disk CURSOR_MOCK=1 node --test 'dist/**/*.test.js' --test 'dist/e2e/*.e2e.js' && node scripts/test-log-timestamps.mjs
scripts.test:dashboard-api: npm run build && CURSOR_MOCK=1 node --test dist/e2e/dashboard-api.e2e.js dist/e2e/dashboard-live-runs.e2e.js dist/e2e/dashboard-run-trace.e2e.js
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && CURSOR_MOCK=1 node --test dist/e2e/heap.e2e.js dist/e2e/swarm-handoff.e2e.js dist/e2e/agent-matrix.e2e.js
scripts.test:e2e:demo: npm run build && LI_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE=disk CURSOR_MOCK=1 node --test dist/e2e/repo-workflow-push.e2e.js dist/e2e/code-implementer-push.e2e.js
scripts.test:e2e:sdk: npm run build && env -u CURSOR_MOCK LI_E2E_SDK=1 node --test dist/e2e/sdk-live.e2e.js
scripts.test:e2e:lidb: npm run build && LI_CONTROL_PLANE_STORE=lidb LI_E2E_LIDB=1 node --test dist/e2e/lidb-control-plane.e2e.js
scripts.smoke:li-demo:live: npm run build && env -u CURSOR_MOCK -u LI_REPO_WORKFLOW_USE_FIXTURE -u LI_REPO_WORKFLOW_SKIP_PUSH node scripts/live-li-demo-smoke.mjs
scripts.verify:agents:live: npm run build && env -u CURSOR_MOCK LI_REPO_WORKFLOW_SKIP_PUSH=1 LI_REPO_WORKFLOW_USE_FIXTURE=1 node scripts/verify-all-agents-live.mjs
scripts.ci: npm run build && CURSOR_MOCK=1 npm test && node dist/cli/run-agent.js --agent orchestrator --mock --dry-run && node dist/cli/supervisor.js --once --mock
